Note: The comic updates with a single page a week on Friday. I try to upload consistently, but I sometimes take a few days to update this gallery. There are also sometimes individual sketches and random single-page comics uploaded either with or in-between the comic pages, but I absolutely despise those comic galleries where they keep getting updated only for it to just be a dozen random sketches and not the comic (or when half the gallery is just WIP's or sketches), so I will not be uploading the sketches in this gallery. I'll likely just end up making them their own gallery if I decide to upload them at all.
